turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
A damaged item is handled separately from a normal return: for damage, you should email sales@glasswareuk.co.uk with your order number and clear photos of the defective item, and the team will review it. For a normal return, the item must be unused, requested within 30 days, and you can view the policy here: https://glasswareuk.co.uk/policies/refund-policy. Returns are usually processed within 5 business days of the returns department receiving them.
